onnxruntime-web 1.27.0 — MIT
https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime

Fetched by tools/bakeoff/install-extension-assets.mjs, not committed:
  ort.bundle.min.mjs                entry point (WASM + WebGPU)
  ort-wasm-simd-threaded.jsep.mjs   glue, dynamically imported by it
  ort-wasm-simd-threaded.jsep.wasm  the binary

MV3 forbids remote code, so the runtime ships with the extension rather than
loading from a CDN.

DO NOT hand-pick these companion files. ORT ships four interchangeable WASM
variants — plain, jsep, asyncify, jspi — and each entry point imports exactly
one pair, with no relationship to its own name: ort.bundle.min.mjs wants jsep,
ort.webgpu.bundle.min.mjs wants asyncify. The installer reads the entry point
and copies what it actually references. Shipping the wrong pair fails at
runtime as "no available backend found", naming neither file nor variant.
